plain.li: [temper:brave,predator] Good {PET_nameDef}, hold there, it's seen you.
[temper:brave,predator] Look at {PET_nameDef}, squaring up to it like it's nothing.
[temper:brave,predator] Easy, {PET_nameDef}, I see it too.
[temper:timid,stranger] {PET_nameDef} has gone and hidden again, the strangers scare it.
[temper:timid,stranger] It's all right, {PET_nameDef}, they're only visitors.
[temper:timid,stranger] Somebody tell {PET_nameDef} the guests don't bite.
[temper:greedy,table] Hey, off the table, {PET_nameDef}!
[temper:greedy,table] Whose supper was that, {PET_nameDef}?
[temper:greedy,table] That was somebody's {THING}, you greedy thing.
[temper:greedy,stores] {PET_nameDef} has been at the stores again.
[temper:greedy,stores] Out of the stores, thief, that's the colony's {THING}.
[temper:greedy,stores] No wonder the {THING} keeps going down.
[temper:gentle,bedside] Look, {PET_nameDef} has come to keep {OTHER_nameDef} company.
[temper:gentle,bedside] {PET_nameDef} won't leave {OTHER_nameDef}'s side, bless it.
[temper:gentle,bedside] Let it stay, {OTHER_nameDef} sleeps better with {PET_nameDef} there.
[temper:proud,jealous] Yes, yes, you're still the best of them, {PET_nameDef}.
[temper:proud,jealous] Jealous of {OTHER_nameDef}, are we?
[temper:proud,jealous] Move over, {PET_nameDef}, I can't work with you underfoot.
[temper:proud,visitors] {PET_nameDef} is showing off for the visitors again.
[temper:proud,visitors] Look at {PET_nameDef}, strutting about like it owns the place.
[temper:proud,visitors] Don't mind {PET_nameDef}, it likes to be admired.
[temper:mischievous,crops] {PET_nameDef}, get out of the field, that's our harvest!
[temper:mischievous,crops] Who left the field open for {PET_nameDef} again?
[temper:mischievous,crops] There goes another {THING}, thanks to {PET_nameDef}.
[temper:mischievous,shelf] {PET_nameDef}, did you knock that over?
[temper:mischievous,shelf] Somebody put the {THING} back, {PET_nameDef} has been at the shelves.
[temper:mischievous,shelf] I just tidied that, you menace.
[temper:loyal,door] {PET_nameDef} is at the door again, waiting for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[temper:loyal,door] They'll be back soon, {PET_nameDef}, come away from the door.
[temper:loyal,door] {PET_nameDef} hasn't left that door since {OTHER_nameDef} went.
[temper:loyal,bed] {PET_nameDef} is lying by {OTHER_nameDef}'s bed again.
[temper:loyal,bed] Poor thing, it misses {OTHER_nameDef}.
[temper:loyal,home] There you are, {PET_nameDef}, did you wait for me?
[temper:loyal,home] I missed you too, {PET_nameDef}.
[temper:loyal,home] Hello, hello, yes, I'm home.
[temper:lazy,fire] {PET_nameDef} has found the warmest spot in the colony, of course.
[temper:lazy,fire] Don't step on {PET_nameDef}, it's asleep by the fire.
[temper:lazy,shade] {PET_nameDef} has the right idea, out of the heat.
[temper:lazy,shade] Some of us have to work, {PET_nameDef}.
[temper:lazy,sun] Look at {PET_nameDef}, flat out in the sun.
[temper:lazy,sun] Asleep again, {PET_nameDef}, at this hour?
[temper:curious,stranger] {PET_nameDef}, leave our guests alone.
[temper:curious,stranger,!body:bird] Sorry, {PET_nameDef} has to sniff everyone who comes.
[temper:curious,stranger,body:bird] Sorry, {PET_nameDef} has to peck at everyone who comes.
[temper:curious,stranger] {PET_nameDef} wants to know where you've been, that's all.
[temper:curious,work] Come to supervise, {PET_nameDef}?
[temper:curious,work,!body:bird] Mind your nose, {PET_nameDef}, this is sharp.
[temper:curious,work] {PET_nameDef} watches me work like it means to learn the trade.
[temper:greedy,pokemon] Not the berries, {PET_nameDef}, those are for training.
[temper:lazy,oldanimal] Sleep, old one, you've earned it.
[temper:mischievous,young] You're a little terror, {PET_nameDef}, do you know that?

warm.li: [temper:gentle,bedside] Good {PET_nameDef}, you always know who needs you.
[temper:loyal,home] I thought of you every night, {PET_nameDef}.

cheerful.li: [temper:proud,visitors] Isn't {PET_nameDef} gorgeous, go on, say it!

gloomy.li: [temper:greedy,table|stores] Even the animals eat better than I do.
[temper:loyal,door] At least somebody waits for people around here.

cold.li: [temper:mischievous,shelf] That animal needs a firmer hand.
[temper:timid,stranger] It will have to learn that guests are useful.

plain.li: [friends] {PET_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef}, inseparable as ever.
[friends] Look at those two, thick as thieves.
[friends] Where {OTHER_nameDef} goes, {PET_nameDef} goes.
[friends,catdog] A cat and a dog, friends, now I've seen everything.
[friends,samekind] Those two would share one bed if we let them.
[rivals] Leave it, {PET_nameDef}, you two will never get on.
[rivals] Here we go again, {PET_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef}.
[rivals,!body:bird] Somebody separate those two before there's fur everywhere.
[rivals,catdog] Cat and dog, every single day.
[rivals] One day they'll be friends, and I'll be too old to see it.
[grave,person] {PET_nameDef} is out at {OTHER_nameDef}'s grave again.
[grave,person] Let it be, it misses {OTHER_nameDef} as much as any of us.
[grave,person] Every day it lies there, waiting for {OTHER_nameDef} to get up.
[grave,friend] {PET_nameDef} is lying by {OTHER_nameDef}'s grave again.
[grave,friend] It still goes looking for {OTHER_nameDef}, you know.
[grave,friend] They were never apart, those two, and now look at it.
[knowsme] {PET_nameDef}, is that you?
[knowsme] You remember me, don't you, {PET_nameDef}?
[knowsme,wild] Look at you, {PET_nameDef}, gone all wild.
[knowsme] Hello, old friend, I never thought I'd see you again.
[knowsme,again] Back to see me again, {PET_nameDef}?
[knowsme,sold] They're treating you well, I hope, {PET_nameDef}.

blunt.li: [rivals] Pack it in, both of you.

cheerful.li: [friends] Best friends, the pair of them, it warms the heart.

gloomy.li: [grave,person] Even the animals know we lost the best of us.

cold.li: [rivals] They'll settle it themselves, or they won't.

plain.li: [temper:loyal,home] {PET_nameDef} was at the door when I got home. They say it waited there most days I was gone.
[temper:loyal,home] Came home to {PET_nameDef} at the door. I don't know which of us was gladder.
[temper:loyal,home] {PET_nameDef} hasn't let me out of its sight since I got back.
[temper:brave,fight] In the fight {PET_nameDef} planted itself between me and them and wouldn't move. I owe it.
[temper:brave,fight] {PET_nameDef} stood in front of me when they came. I didn't ask it to. I'd never have asked it to.
[temper:brave,fight,pokemon] {PET_nameDef} took its stand without a word from me. No trainer could ask for more.

warm.li: [temper:loyal,home] Home, and {PET_nameDef}'s nose in my hand before I'd put my pack down.

gloomy.li: [temper:brave,fight] {PET_nameDef} would have died for me today. I'm not sure I'm worth it.

cold.li: [temper:brave,fight] {PET_nameDef} held its ground in the fight. A good animal. Better trained than I knew.

plain.li: [friends] {PET_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} sleep curled up together every night now. I've stopped trying to keep them apart.
[friends] {PET_nameDef} has a friend: {OTHER_nameDef}. They sleep in a heap and wake up in one.
[friends,catdog] {PET_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} are friends. A cat and a dog. Nobody told them they shouldn't be.
[rivals] {PET_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} have declared war, and the rest of us live in it.
[rivals] {PET_nameDef} can't stand {OTHER_nameDef}. Nobody knows why. I don't think they do either.
[rivals,catdog] {PET_nameDef} went for {OTHER_nameDef} again. Cats and dogs: some things don't change, out here or anywhere.
[grave,person] {PET_nameDef} lay on {OTHER_nameDef}'s grave again this morning. Nobody had the heart to call it away.
[grave,person] {PET_nameDef} goes out to {OTHER_nameDef} every day or two. I go too, sometimes, and sit with it.
[grave,friend] {PET_nameDef} went to {OTHER_nameDef}'s grave and lay there half the day. I didn't know animals did that.
[knowsme,wild] Saw {PET_nameDef} today, wild as anything, and it came straight to me as if it had never gone.
[knowsme,sold] {PET_nameDef} knew me. It's someone else's now, and it still knew me.

warm.li: [knowsme] {PET_nameDef} remembered me. I cried, and I'm not ashamed of it.

gloomy.li: [grave,person] Even the animal grieves properly. I can't seem to.

plain.li: [gift:mind] {PET_nameDef} spoke to me today, inside my head, as clear as anyone. I haven't told the others yet.
[gift:mind] There was a voice in my head this morning that wasn't mine. It was {PET_nameDef}, and it was laughing at me.
[gift:commune] The old ways worked. {PET_nameDef} and I spoke, really spoke, and it had been waiting a long time to.
[gift:psylink] Through the link I heard {PET_nameDef} today. Not words exactly. But I understood every one.
[gift:hybrid] {PET_nameDef} talks. Properly. The lab said it might. I didn't believe them until it asked what was for supper.
